title: Vori Vori
description: Vori Vori is a dish from Paraguay featuring chicken thigh, yellow onion, carrot, cornmeal. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used. Cornmeal stands in for Paraguayan cornflour/bespoke vorí mixture.

steps.instruction: Combine these ingredients in a pot, bring just to a boil and skim any foam. Simmer gently for about 48 minutes to make a flavorful base.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Roll the cornmeal-cheese mixture into small dumpling balls with damp hands, keeping them uniform for simmering in the soup.
Cook dumplings in batches in gently boiling salted water for about 16 minutes, until they float and the filling is cooked through. Lift out with a slotted spoon.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
